empty_note: What a session asks you, and every release to approve, comes here.
inbox_load_failed: The inbox could not be loaded. It tries again in a few seconds.
question_free: {ticket} · to answer in your own words
shot_none: No picture of this screen yet.
confirm_send_back: Send this release back? The ticket returns to Todo and the author starts again from it.
grace_label: Time left to undo the approval
sent_back: Sent back at {time}. The ticket is in Todo and the author starts again.
deny_default: Denied from the inbox. Find another way, or ask in a message.
answered_allow_once: Allowed once. The session goes on.
answered_allow_always: Allowed, and always in this project from now on. The session goes on.
answered_reject_once: Denied. The session was told why.
answered_answer: Answer sent. The session goes on.
settled: This request was settled without you: the session was interrupted or ended, or someone answered it from the session.
handled_note: This no longer waits for you.
gone: This item is no longer in the inbox.
free_answer: Or answer in your own words
answer_settled: Already settled without you. The inbox was refreshed.
answer_failed: The answer did not reach the service. Try again.
approve_owner: Only the project's owner can approve a release.
approve_conflict: The service refused: the release changed, or an approval is already counting down. The inbox was refreshed.
approve_setup: Approval is not set up on the service yet: run npm run setup there.
approve_failed: The approval did not reach the service. Try again.
undo_late: Too late to undo: the approval was written.
undo_failed: Undo did not reach the service. Try again before the end of the grace.
send_back_conflict: The ticket could not go back to Todo: it is being worked on, or it moved.
send_back_failed: Sending back did not reach the service. Try again.
